title: Ranks
prompt:
**Description:** For each of n values, print its **dense rank**: the
position of its value in the ascending order of DISTINCT values
(1-based). Equal values share the same rank; ranks are consecutive.

**Input:** Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 10^5). Line 2: n integers (|a_i| <= 10^9).
**Output:** n integers — the ranks in input order.

**Example:** `4` / `30 10 20 10` -> `3 1 2 1` (distinct: 10 20 30).

tests.name: sample
tests.hint: Dense ranks: distinct values 10 20 30; tied 10s share rank 1.

all equal
